entities.summary: Tunisian Arabic, or simply Tunisian, is a variety of Arabic spoken in Tunisia. It is known among its 13 million speakers as Tūnsi, "Tunisian" or Derja to distinguish it from Modern Standard Arabic, the official language of Tunisia. Tunisian Arabic is mostly similar to eastern Algerian Arabic and western Libyan Arabic. Tunisian Arabic is a modern language with roots in Africa. A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
